bridge-type.label: Modbus Poller (modern channel model)
bridge-type.description: Regular poll that owns user-defined Modbus channels.

parameter.name: refresh
parameter.label: Poll Interval
parameter.description: Poll interval in milliseconds. Use zero to disable automatic polling.

parameter.name: start
parameter.label: Start
parameter.description: Zero-based address of the first register, coil, or discrete input to poll.

parameter.name: length
parameter.label: Length
parameter.description: Number of registers, coils, or discrete inputs to read.

parameter.name: cacheMillis
parameter.label: Cache Duration
parameter.description: Duration for serving REFRESH commands from the poll response cache.
